maddeler.e:
شللتما (form I)
# شَلِلْتُمَا (šaliltumā) /ʃa.lil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شَلَلْتُمَا (šalaltumā) /ʃa.lal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of شَلَّ (šalla)
# شُلِلْتُمَا (šuliltumā) /ʃu.lil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
